name: DonutShop v0.7.8
body:
**Sleep/Wake UI experience**
- When DonutShop detects "remote pwr" (sleep) has been sent to the RT4K, or the WebCtl remote power button has been pressed, WebCtl will exit out to the connect page. 
  - Unfortunately, it cannot detect when the RT4K builtin IR receiver is sent a sleep IR code. In this scenario, WebCtl will not exit and a manual page refresh is required for it to notice.
- When DonutShop detects "pwr on" (wake) has been sent to the RT4K, all connected WebCtl pages reload so they reconnect to the awake RT4K. 
  - does not apply to when the RT4K builtin IR receiver was used to wake.
- Works great with the IR Receiver of the Donut Dongle.
